fields.label: Action
fields.help: The name of the action associated with the intent.

fields.label: Default Response Platforms
fields.help: The list of platforms for which the first responses will be copied from the messages in PLATFORM_UNSPECIFIED (i.e.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Display Name
fields.help: The name of this intent to be displayed on the console.

fields.label: Events
fields.help: The collection of event names that trigger the intent.

fields.label: Input Context Names
fields.help: The list of context names required for this intent to be triggered.

fields.label: Is Fallback
fields.help: Indicates whether this is a fallback intent.

fields.label: Ml Disabled
fields.help: Indicates whether Machine Learning is disabled for the intent.

fields.label: Parent Followup Intent Name
fields.help: The unique identifier of the parent intent in the chain of followup intents.

fields.label: Reset Contexts
fields.help: Indicates whether to delete all contexts in the current session when this intent is matched.

fields.label: Webhook State
fields.help: Indicates whether webhooks are enabled for the intent.
